t: High performance, multi-material, long-life aluminium oxide abrasive. Provides up to 3 times longer life than conventional abrasives. Suitable for wood, paint, plaster and metal. Designed to produce high quality, consistent results whether at trade professional or keen hobbyist level. Increased spacing between the grit particles reduces clogging and allows fast stock removal, especially on gummy, resinous timbers, fillers and during paint removal. Dual resin bonding layers keep the abrasive grit firmly bonded to the backer for increased lifespan. Hook and loop fixings give a secure fix to the power tool base and offer fast, easy removal, increasing productivity when working through grits. Ideal for general sanding applications.
b: Suitable for Sanding Wood, Paint, Metal & Plaster
Elongated Hole Pattern for Maximum Extraction
